text:
Ivy: Dropping a shelf-focused sketch for the compare table. Main asks: 1) how to present perf badges in high-density rows, 2) pinning copy and scope, 3) keyboard flow for collapsed filters. figma: https://figma.redwood/compare-shelf-ux :mag:

Jon: Nice. For density, propose a compact badge mode (icon + number) and a standard mode (colored pill + number). Default to standard on first-run, let power users toggle compact in profile.

Priya: Copy: for pin tooltip use: "Pin version to this compare. Persists in this browser." If we later support account persistence we'll update to "Persists across devices." Also show a brief snackbar: "Pinned. Undo" after pin/unpin.

Kei: Keyboard: collapsed filter control should be a button with aria-expanded and aria-controls. When expanded inline, focus should move to the first filter and Tab should cycle through filters; Escape collapses. Support Shift+Arrow for range selections.

A11yBot: Checklist: badges need aria-labels (e.g. "Latency p95 120ms"). Color not sole cue: include icon or textual label. Provide SR-only status messages when pin toggles.

Ivy: Visual idea: when pinning animate a micro star that briefly appears over the thumbnail then shows a small "Pinned" label. Keep motion short (120ms) and respect reduced-motion.

Jon: Also consider URL behavior: encode pins and visible filters in the query string for easy sharing. Use short keys like ?p=md1,md4&f=acc-1. We'll revisit storage sync later.

Priya: Microcopy for share snackbar: "Compare link copied — includes pins and filters". Keeps expectations clear.

Kei: A11y micro-snippet for the pin button: <button aria-pressed="false" aria-label="Pin version v3.0 to compare">📌</button>. Add offscreen text that updates to "Pinned" on change so SRs announce it.

Ivy: Great feedback. Next steps: Jon, add compact badge mock + gif of pin animation. Kei, prototype keyboard flow. Priya, I'll drop updated copy into figma. Booking a 20m sync tomorrow. Thanks! :sparkles:
